# Fusion Updates

> Fusion Updates (fusionupdates.com) is an independent, plain-English tracker of Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly updates for Financials, Procurement, Supply Chain & Manufacturing, Logistics, Project Management and HCM: what changed, what switches on automatically, which former opt-ins are now standard, and what to test. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle.

Updated 19 October 2026. Fusion Updates turns Oracle's quarterly What's New documents into plain English. The current update is 26C: we track 148 changes, 120 of them delivered switched on, and Oracle lists 36 former opt-ins now standard with 26C. 26D is next: Oracle's 26D What's New lists 768 features across the modules we cover, and 23 opt-ins end with 26D.

How it is built: features come from the Feature Summary tables in Oracle's What's New documents; enablement comes from Oracle's "Action to Enable" column plus Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list. "Impact on upgrade" (high, medium, low) is our editorial rating; "Oracle scale" is copied from Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes" column. Every entry links to its Oracle source page. The site is refreshed every week from Oracle's documents.

## FAQ

- **What is the current Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update?** 26C is the current update on this site and 26D is next. Oracle updates environments in cohorts: test environments on the first Friday of the update month and production two weeks later, on the third Friday. Your cohort is shown in the Oracle Cloud Console.
- **What switches on automatically in 26C?** 120 of the 148 26C changes we track are delivered switched on, so users may see them without anyone acting. [See the ones rated medium or high impact](https://fusionupdates.com/updates/26c/checklist.html#auto).
- **Which former opt-ins are now standard in 26C?** Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list names 36 features whose opt-in period ended with 26C: 14 are switched on for everyone and 22 need setup. [See them](https://fusionupdates.com/26c/former-opt-ins-now-standard/).
- **What's new in Oracle Fusion 26D?** Oracle's 26D What's New documents list 768 features across the modules we cover: 173 on by default, 124 on by default with potential setup, 361 setup required, 89 opt-in, 21 needing another action, per Oracle's "Action to Enable" column. 23 opt-ins also end with 26D. [26D by module](https://fusionupdates.com/26d/).
- **What should I test after an Oracle Fusion quarterly update?** Start with a baseline regression: validate your current configuration, key end-to-end business flows, integrations, critical reports, custom workflows and extensions, security for new or changed pages, and the features switched on automatically. Our [26C what-to-test checklist](https://fusionupdates.com/updates/26c/checklist.html) adds the changes and former opt-ins for 26C.
- **Is Fusion Updates affiliated with Oracle?** No. It's an independent site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle. Summaries are condensed from Oracle's public readiness documentation, and every entry links to its Oracle source page.
